items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got a chance to hang out with him and find out what kind of guy he was

ctx.x: My grandfather’s name was Major Evans. He was a businessman. He was always doing something to create a livelihood. His favorite hobby was picking up the back end of a – what do they call the first Fords? The A something? T. Model T Ford – he would go pick up the back end of the Model T Ford. That’s how he showed his prowess, “my strength.” I remember that story, because my father made a point of getting me to hear that story, and I’ve always respected – I wanted to see him do it. I never saw him do it, though.…
It sounds like your father’s side of the family was native in Pittsburgh?
